## Problem and resulting native behavior

The typed owner needs real int64 Tensor storage, exact integer-to-binary32 conversion, correct mixed-operation layouts and actual view-base lifetimes. A copied floating-point payload or a metadata-only alias cannot provide those semantics.

This PR adds a separate native HIA profile with eight-byte int64 Storage; qualified typed add/subtract/multiply/bitwise operations/true division; Tensor-RHS in-place variants; a distinct Scalar add_ path; round-to-nearest-even conversion; actual common-dtype temporary allocation and release; and real ultimate-base Tensor roots for int64 views. Explicit int64 dropout commits its observed completed prefix and RNG advancement before stopping on its runtime error. Ordinary admission errors preserve full-frame rollback.

All production math, conversion, allocation and lifetime execute in HIA. Python assembles source, transports requests and independently reviews evidence.

## Exact source and dependency

- Head: `3430891413ae0eac1fdcc65eb6fcd202ad108331`.
- Tree: `a5a39214f69025502ba92e6b0fe3cfdb016c81c4`.
- Sole parent: PR #32 head `b9e74758e4a30389e278d0b7b034ecf53e8a550c`.
- Native source: `adf6cae67666273aa6fb77989080ca3b1e3632188d2d7956a6d8b71808787e62`.
- Native ELF: `b7324639bade3312981d1cbf9c2491b9fcff04fb6c3f808e9c5e1a7c2ca88f08`.
- 544 functions, 7,263 blocks, 26,361 instructions, eleven native modules, full 640-byte descriptors, HTINT002/HTOINT02.

**PR #32 was merged at 2026-11-16T16:51:53Z as `08170754bf242220d622ea2bca3c2c376b5f37d7`. This exact source has now completed its own PR and push CI and full original-artifact admission.** The prospective merge against that main commit independently produces this exact `a5a39214f69025502ba92e6b0fe3cfdb016c81c4` tree. All 153 changed/added paths were bound to the reviewed staged tree. Twenty large blobs were individually uploaded through the connector and matched to their immutable local Git identities; the remote tree and commit were read back exactly.

## Actually executed local qualification

The original portable producer rebuilt all eleven units and passed ten named gates: cold build; the disjoint original54 storage/arithmetic/dropout partitions; alias8; 1,237 rounding inputs; promotion20; view-base6; independent inplace40; and the old behavior coordinator. The latter executes twelve gates including the original sixteen inherited suites and bounded retained12. These groups overlap and are not summed as unique upstream APIs.

The new root coordinator then performed another actual cold build and executed all four outer gates against its resulting image:

| Gate | Actual scoped result |
| --- | --- |
| Fresh producer | All ten named gates and exact eleven-unit reconstruction |
| Independent resources | Six cases, 527 frames, 157 checks, 44,811,376 rollback bytes |
| Owned entry | Five cases, 46 native probe processes, 33 interactive frames |
| Previous/new typed owner handoff | Two directions, 23 native modules, thirteen frames, 1,398,048 rollback bytes |

The integrated report is `245257046806b765aee09d4c37d32d99cde8ed31e612f00772021ef9eb1bb781`. All 219 recorded inputs remained unchanged. Complete raw evidence contains 1,772 original members and 190,519,578 original file bytes; every size, mode, SHA-256 and single XZ stream EOF was checked. See `validation/integer-tensors/integration-final/`.

An independent source review rechecked all 219 files, original process results and the create-only cold path, with no blocker found in its stated scope. It claims no second native execution or hosted qualification.

## New full-reference gates

A separate source-bound observer namespace reads all eighty descriptor words. It retains all original numerical oracles, error/refusal rules, provenance checks, EOF and post-close parameter-Version conditions. Its six adaptations have exact whole-file inverses. All 544 native function bodies and actual capture callers are bound; the ten original construction anchors remain identical.

This observer deliberately covers the original35 F32 command domain. It requires every actual int64-extension word at offsets 576–639 to be zero, so it does not claim general int64 view-root certification.

Independent ROG jobs actually passed the unchanged live32 and complete35 workloads on this exact new image. Live32 passed 32/32 cases, 2,132 frames, 17,455 exact binary32 words and 1,137,600 serialized RNG bytes. Complete35 passed 35/35 cases, 6,344 frames and 2,590,274 values, followed by the original strict checker, four positive controls and eighteen copied refusals. All eleven provenance checks, original EOF obligations and parameter-Version conditions remain enforced.

**Complete local byte-custody admission has now passed.** The original single-XZ raw archive is 10,569,040 bytes, SHA-256 `db30ecb2c922bcd2c63106d1bb68801a2d0a76c08d331e6d7def545fe1f61671`; all 290 members and 48,715,546 expanded file bytes were checked for exact size, hash and mode. A separate 21-payload evidence handoff has manifest `cc5036affc7a4aa38e8eaa7acb2aab1717f968dc01aae3d0f55e349c3d79a3d1` and qualification `480db7bb041ce694c1dc019d89a43a1e40a82db26e9c2cf69c70f0520ca5426d`. The integration owner copied and reverified the complete handoff and reran its byte-only verifier successfully; that recheck does not claim a new native or Torch execution.

Original first preparation/sealing failures, corrections, process responses and fixed-version byte-read receipts remain in the separate historical archive. The committed observer source handoff retains its original PREPARED_NOT_RUN identity. These remote reference results remain separate from the completed hosted CI admission recorded below.

CI preserves every one of the prior 83 explicit steps and 38 report obligations, adding eight steps and five separate reports. The resulting 91-step/43-report workflow keeps the 90-minute outer budget. New runtime evidence and complete observer journals have independent artifact names.

## Completed hosted qualification at the exact source head

Both actual Native HIA jobs completed every one of their 96 recorded steps successfully: PR run 43909954525 / job 133448845058 and push run 43909769912 / job 133448179659. All nine source-head checks passed. The separate quick run 43909954487 completed the original 355/428/446 profiles; its independent byte reader passed 54,017 checks with zero failures.

The 17 original ZIP artifacts total 237,878,878 bytes. Their original index SHA-256 is `6564104d28359075d11ab1aee3fa980b86c471e7c303f31fcb6e740bcccc5604`. The full independent reader bound all original report bytes, all 77 native reports and 43 envelopes per Native job, complete archives, process identities, sources, eleven modules, raw wire data and complete owner transitions. It read all 6,344 accounted35 transitions for each of the 523 and 544 profiles.

| Actual artifact admission | Passed / failed | Original report SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| PR Native | 217,481 / 0 | `2914eff0dc95ccb522564e571129a69a6c0740332d694ad42207b6cfe8d487b1` |
| Push Native | 217,482 / 0 | `9fa95d2cb38e97e3d6f6579b2fb4d8147882b7904b8609d2ac41a23365a6c5a1` |

The integration owner independently executed the complete push reader. Its report is byte-identical to the separate reviewer's push report. These are offline artifact admissions, not additional native or Torch executions.

The one-check PR/push difference was traced exactly to the unchanged 523 helper's 1 MiB compressed-input loop. The PR XZ is 4,189,036 bytes (four loop checks); push is 4,211,232 bytes (five). Both complete single-stream EOF and tar-byte SHA checks passed. All other diagnostic check-category counts match; neither original reports nor admission values were normalized.

The original r02 reader failure after 87,787 checks remains retained. It compared eleven public10 owner-digest strings against an older owner layout. Revision r03 explicitly distinguishes those source-bound executed rollback observations from offline byte recomputation: the historical suite preserved complete request/reply transport and reports but did not archive those eleven owner buffers. The whole case structure, equivalence relations, 1,036 actual raw frames, 5,975 exact comparisons and 7,689,264 executed rollback bytes remain bound. The complete original `Check.run` source still performs full before/after owner equality. No missing owner buffer is invented. All other reader helpers and original copied refusal rules remain unchanged.

The first r03 PR process ended with shell exit 137 and no completed report. This interruption is preserved without assigning an unproven kernel-OOM cause or a semantic pass. The later sequential PR execution completed normally and produced the admitted report above. The r03 reader source is `8c612cc4390c44adb4fc1c4f1f8d36484a6809d011babb9bb9f8baa9e8d5cea5`; the integer helper is `6ae2f53cfd97f39ca18924d7ccc606e86ccd218a84e714cff99d6f68aa6bc734`. Its copied control run passed 4,221 positive checks and six required refusals.

The originally executed PR checkout is `0d3d68ca0adc8aa6e0d24a25002b4821b5c60b99`. The later prospective merge after PR #32 is `b0eccc9552ec1cae6dccbd8c026536159bec569c`, with exact ordered parents `08170754bf242220d622ea2bca3c2c376b5f37d7` and `3430891413ae0eac1fdcc65eb6fcd202ad108331`. Both trees equal the qualified `a5a39214f69025502ba92e6b0fe3cfdb016c81c4`; the later prospective commit is not relabelled as the original executed checkout.

## Original failures and remaining scope

Candidate06's actual inplace40 result was 37/40, with two nondense-overlap admissions and one overlap-before-cast error-priority difference. Three HIA functions were corrected; the identical reference and reader then passed all forty cases on candidate07. Both original reports and complete raw evidence remain.

The initial 64 MiB resource test did not trigger allocation failure and stays failed. A separately recorded 56 MiB run triggered a real native allocation failure, checked full rollback and completed recovery. Earlier alias, promotion, lifetime and preparation failures remain intact. The reference-copy mode correction is explicit and preserves original bytes and historical mode inside its archive.

Public Tensor.to, mixed F32/int64 autograd, complete dtype-dependent operators, broader layout/device/mode behavior and Python object/exception parity remain open. The old F32/bool command69 alias contract is not relabelled as a true int64-style base view.

The frozen full target remains PyTorch 2.15.0 at `31a77fc9c0a7c6fff15a1ff58c743f53b1a9d457`: **2,590 schemas, 688 derivatives, seventeen whole-system gates, zero complete-schema parity, HOLD**. The actual full-acceptance command still exits 2; the accounting checker passes without closing any gate.
